title: Operator-First research master
description:
Formal proofs, research notes and instrumentation from the Operator-First research programme. Includes Lean formalizations audited to a fixed trust base, the Compound Eye instrument and its append-only hash-chained event ledger, the two-adic counting lemma and exact n-step Syracuse digit law, and Andrews-Curtis corridor search tooling.

Authorship. The logic, theories, planning and research direction are the author's. Mathematical assistance was provided by AI systems; that assistance is credited as such and does not constitute authorship of the research programme.

This deposit is archived from the GitHub repository and the two records are intended to be read together: the DOI below is the citable archive, the repository is the working source.
notes: Mixed licensing: original code, Lean sources, scripts and CI are MIT; original scholarly prose, notes, figures and author-owned research data are CC BY 4.0. Third-party material retains its original terms. See LICENSE.
references: Robert Sneiderman, ac-square-divisibility, https://github.com/Robby955/ac-square-divisibility (commit d0ed2c06). Cited wherever root-conjugacy, donor-restoration, coordinate-transport, divisibility, period or companion-restoration ideas are used.
